description: Name of the R data package as given in its DESCRIPTION file.
Title of the package from the DESCRIPTION Title field.
One-paragraph description of the package from the DESCRIPTION Description field with whitespace collapsed.
Package version from DESCRIPTION with any leading v stripped.
Catalog tier assigned by the version-tier policy with levels dev then candidate then catalogued.
Whether the package was catalogued through the transitional grandfather rule rather than a completed review.
Name of the package maintainer taken from the Authors@R person with the cre role.
ORCID identifier of the maintainer when present in Authors@R.
All authors with aut or cre roles collapsed into one string separated by semicolons.
License of the package from the DESCRIPTION License field.
Date given in the DESCRIPTION Date field when present.
Zenodo DOI recorded in the package CITATION.cff file when present.
Version recorded in CITATION.cff used as a drift diagnostic against the DESCRIPTION version.
URL of the package repository on GitHub.
URL of the package documentation website.
Number of datasets shipped in the package data directory.
Tag name of the latest GitHub release when one exists.
Default branch of the package repository.
Date the package repository was created on GitHub.
Date of the most recent push to the package repository.
GitHub repository topics collapsed into one string separated by semicolons.
Whether the package ships a data-raw dictionary.csv file.
Whether the package ships export files in inst/extdata.
Name of the package the dataset belongs to.
Name of the dataset taken from its rda file name.
Title of the dataset from the first line of its roxygen documentation.
Description of the dataset from its roxygen documentation before the format tag.
Number of rows stated in the roxygen format tag.
Number of variables stated in the roxygen format tag.
Number of rows for this dataset in the package dictionary used as a cross check.
Direct download URL of the CSV export when the package ships one.
Direct download URL of the XLSX export when the package ships one.
Name of the package the variable belongs to.
Name of the dataset the variable belongs to.
Name of the variable as given in the package dictionary.
Type of the variable as given in the package dictionary.
Plain language description of the variable from the package dictionary.
